sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - MPX is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "A guy came by recently looking for the right weapon to settle a score with Reshala from the dorms. I don't particularly like that... person, so I agreed to help. But I don't have enough hands to do everything myself. That's where you come in. Build an MPX with a Tactical Dynamics Skeletonized pistol grip, Annihilator flash hider, and a Steiner LAS/TAC 2 flashlight. It needs a sighting range above 300, ergonomics at or above 47, a weight below 4 kg, and combined recoil below 225. Don't tell anyone what this is for. Rumors spread quickly in Tarkov, and Reshala definitely won't be happy if word gets out."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a SIG MPX to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Tech manual
- Unlocks purchase of Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle (variant SOPMOD I) at Mechanic LL3
- Unlocks purchase of Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle (variant SAI) at Ref LL3
"Finished? Excellent. Bring it here, I'll pass it on to the client as soon as possible."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
MPX specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 300 or greater sighting range
- 47 or more ergonomics
- 4 kg or less in weight
- 225 or less recoil
- AR-15 Tactical Dynamics Skeletonized pistol grip
- Yankee Hill Annihilator multi-caliber flash hider
- Steiner LAS/TAC 2 tactical flashlight

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard MPX from Peacekeeper LL2.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
